blocks.text: Cryptocurrencies aur smart contracts ne digital maaliyat (finance) aur decentralized applications mein bari tabdeeliyan ki hain. Cryptocurrencies aisi digital currencies (raqam) hain jo riwayati bankon ke baghair chalti hain aur duniya bhar mein logon ke darmiyan seedhi transactions mumkin banati hain. Smart contracts code mein likhe hue khud kaar muahide (agreements) hain jo kuch khaas sharait poori hone par khud chal jate hain. Yeh dono technologies mil kar paison ke len den aur muahidon ko mehfooz, shaffaf aur kaarkard tareeqe se sambhalti hain.

blocks.prompt: Smart contract ko 'smart' kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke sharait poori hote hi woh apni shartein khud nafiz (execute) kar deta hai; kisi insaan ya darmiyani ko kuch karna nahi parta.

items: Cryptocurrencies: bankon ke baghair digital raqam.
Smart contracts: code mein likhe muahide jo sharait poori hone par khud chalte hain.
